network_enforcement: The checker runs the existing validation Lean replay through bubblewrap --unshare-net with a read-only host root and a fresh writable output directory. Host-side authority, pin, hash, and trust observations make no network request. The shared warm dependency cache remains nonrelease evidence.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED release status summary

scope_boundary: Fail-closed release reconciliation plus the existing same-worker, network-isolated, warm-cache Lean replay. This recipe does not provide master-accepted dependencies, accepted H0/R0 or full trust closure, an immutable clean empty-cache offline build, two independent signed runners, an independently implemented minimal verifier, protected release CI, or a deterministic content-addressed release bundle.
